name: Plane
description: Plane's hosted server for Plane Cloud: the agent can list and create work items, move them through states and read cycles and modules.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.plane.so) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
